_doc: Dark Knight line (spec #348, ticket D2 #350). Skills are defined here by D5-D9 (spec #348). Skill keys a job names before they are defined stay inert: undefined skills are never offered or learned. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in skills/hero.json (DK-13): never define them here.

spear_crusher._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311001 at its eight mapped levels (4 8 12 15 23 25 27 30): damage 70 to 170 %, attackCount 2 (levels 1-15) or 3 (16-30), mobCount 1 to 3, the box lt (-130,-50) growing to (-150,-70) with rb (-16,0) (a 16 px dead zone in front of the knight), the per-level body action (burster1 for two hits, burster2 for three), the wings (effect) and rune rings (effect0), the K-th dragon thrust (effect1..3), hit/0 and the Use sound; the pole arm twin 1311002 has identical numbers and nodes. Tier B: effectK is the K-th thrust (D1 contact sheet; the blank wait of effect1/2/3 is 600/750/900 ms, the body's thrusts land there). Tier C: the explicit ranks table (DK-7: the default level-30 table lands rank 5 on level 19, where mobCount falls back to 1, so the rank would deal less than rank 4), the 0.6 s cooldown, the nearest-target admission (min_targets 1), the bonuses, a Final Attack hit also showing its thrust. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.70.
spear_crusher.name: Spear Crusher
spear_crusher.desc: Thrust your spear into the monsters in front of you, two or three times.

text.desc: Thrust your weapon into the monsters in front of you.

dragon_fury._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311003 damage 80 to 250 % (rank 1 = level 4: 110 %), mobCount 6, hpCon 20 to 30, action swingP1, the reach box = the skill's own afterimage rectangle spear/swingP1 lt (-241,-81) rb (-16,31) (the pole arm twin 1311004 is identical), effect, effect0, hit/0 and the Use sound. Tier C: the 1.2 s cooldown, the box cast needing one mob, the 0.8 s stance hold (the body action's own delays), rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.73.
dragon_fury.name: Dragon Fury
dragon_fury.desc: Swings the spear in a long sweep across six monsters, for a few HP.

text.desc: Sweep your spear or pole arm across a long reach in front of you. Costs HP, never the last point.

sacrifice._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1311005 damage 205 to 350 % (rank 1 = level 4: 220 %), x 20 to 5 (% of the damage dealt, String.wz agrees; rank 1 = 18 %), the effect (2 frames, z -1), the Use sound; no action, no hit, no mobCount, no attackCount in the node. Tier C: the single hit at the held weapon's reach (weapon_reach), the weapon's own first-swing stance and hit spark, the 2.0 s cooldown, the recoil rules (10 % of max HP cap, never the last HP; HpRisk), the dropped defence-disable half (no mob debuff exists), rarity bonuses (Achilles, Berserk). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.73.
sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Deals a heavy blow to one monster within your weapon's reach, hurting you for a share of the damage.

text.desc: Strike one monster within your weapon's reach for a heavy blow. The blow hurts you, but never takes your last HP.
